description: We are primary school student team who are passionate in space and gaming!! We love solving puzzles, exploring the universe, and building awesome games. We are looking for people interested in art, solving puzzles, and exploring the space.
summary:
Space Mission is an interactive educational game designed to make space exploration fun and engaging. Players experience exciting space adventures, complete missions, and solve challenges while learning about space and astronomy.

The project combines gaming, education, and creativity to develop problem-solving skills, encourage curiosity, and inspire young generations to explore the universe.
details:
Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational game developed using Microsoft MakeCode Arcade. It aims to introduce students to the scientific challenges of planning a space mission to Mars.

In this game, students become space mission designers and face challenges that require them to understand and balance important factors, including the mass differences between Earth and Mars, oxygen availability for astronauts, and the energy needed to operate a successful mission.

Through interactive gameplay, players explore how these factors influence mission planning and learn that successful space exploration requires careful resource management and scientific decision-making.

The project combines learning and entertainment to make space science more accessible and exciting for students. It encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and curiosity about space exploration
